metadata.title: Relationship Data Standard (Identification)
metadata.description: Standardised data fields for describing a relationship between two persons or a person and a professional

entities.name: PersonRelationship
entities.description: Attached to a link between two Person objects, this is an object that describes the relationship the latter has to the former.

fields.name: type
fields.description: Code for the kind of the relationship

fields.name: risk
fields.description: Code for the risk level of the relationship.

entities.name: Professional Relationship
entities.description: Attached to a link from a Person to a Professional, this is an object that describes the relationship that the latter has to the former

fields.name: type
fields.description: Code for the kind of the relationship

fields.name: risk
fields.description: Code for the risk level of the relationship.

entities.name: Involvement
entities.description: Attached to a link between an Event or Episode and a Professional, this is an object that describes the invovlement of the professional

fields.name: type
fields.description: Code for the kind of the involvement

fields.name: status
fields.description: Code for the involvement's status (ie. active / inactive)

fields.name: Risk
fields.description: Code for the risk level of the involvement.
